title: Pneumonia Detection Model
description: Developed a deep learning model that analyzes chest x-ray images to detect pneumonia. The model assists in early diagnosis by classifying images as normal or infected with high accuracy.

title: ASL Fingerspelling Translator
description: Real-time American Sign Language (ASL) fingerspelling recognition using a CNN model and OpenCV. Built a web interface for inference using webcam.

title: AI Clinical Chatbot
description:
IN PROGRESS
 Designing a AI-powered chatbot that provides preliminary medical responses based on user symptoms and clinical knowledge.

title: Tweet Sentiment Analysis
description: Built an NLP model that classifies tweets into positive or negative sentiment. It processes text data using feature extraction and machine learning techniques to understand public opinion trends.

title: Breast Cancer Classification
description: Created a machine learning classifier to predict whether breast tumors are malignant or benign based on diagnostic features. The model helps support early detection and decision-making in medical screening process.

title: Obesity Level Prediction
description: Developed a predictive model that estimates obesity risk levels based on lifestyle and health-related attributes. The system identifies key contributing factors to help understand and prevent obesity.

title: House Price Prediction Model
description: Created a regression model that predicts housing prices based on features such as location, size, and amenities. The model helps estimate fair market value for real estate decision-making.

title: AI Connect Four
description: Developed an AI-powered Connect Four game as part of a team project, implementing and comparing two intelligent agents that competed against each other. The project explored game search algorithms, decision-making strategies, and AI performance through head-to-head gameplay.
